description: Describe one collection in detail. Returns the collection metadata plus a properties array — each entry is a property with its type, description, and indexed/filterable/sortable flags. Call list_collections first to find a collection id, then describe_collection to see what is queryable inside it. `indexed: true` means the property appears in query_collection / search_collection results (and may be filterable/sortable). `indexed: false` means the property exists on objects but is not returned by query/search — retrieve it through get_object instead.

collection.description: Collection id (slug-form). Use list_collections to discover available collections.

name: describe_collection

access.description: Persona that can query this collection.

description.description: Collection-level mcp.description, falling back to the schema description.

ownership.description: Set when the collection limits the caller to their own objects, or has fields only the site sets: what the caller sees and may change.

properties.description: One entry per exposed property (mcp.expose:false fields are stripped). Per-property mcp.description is surfaced here when set.

description.description: Resolved property description — mcp.description → help → label.

indexed.description: True when the property appears in query/search results. False = available via get_object only.

type.description: Schema field type (text, number, date, toggle, etc.).

url_pattern.description: URL template for objects, e.g. "/blog/{id}". Empty string when no pattern is configured.
